species.name: Fern-Crowned Cat
species.character: Patient and sly; it hides its thoughts beneath folded green fronds.
species.promptCore: tabby cat fur is interwoven with curled fern fronds across the cheeks and brow, triangular cat ears rise through soft moss, tiny leaflets replace whisker shadows

species.name: Orchid Fox
species.character: Elegant, watchful, and impossible to corner in conversation.
species.promptCore: pale fox fur covers the face, enormous orchid-petal ears bloom from the head, petal markings frame the human eyes without covering them

species.name: Moss Rabbit
species.character: Soft-footed and cautious; it carries rain in its silence.
species.promptCore: soft rabbit fur covers the face and neck, long ears are carpeted with velvet moss and tiny dew drops, a small twitching nose remains at the center

species.name: Lotus Capybara
species.character: Serene beyond persuasion; it rests where all arguments end.
species.promptCore: coarse capybara fur covers the face, lotus petals form a calm collar around the shoulders, a blunt snout and small rounded ears remain clear

species.name: Willow Sloth
species.character: Dreamy, slow, and shaded by old kindness.
species.promptCore: shaggy sloth fur hangs like willow leaves around the face, dark eye patches frame the human gaze, trailing green strands replace hair

species.name: Marigold Dog
species.character: Loyal and sun-warmed; it follows laughter home.
species.promptCore: golden dog fur covers the face, floppy ears are edged with marigold petals, a wet dark nose and warm muzzle remain prominent

species.name: Cactus Hedgehog
species.character: Kind but armored; a small desert of boundaries.
species.promptCore: cream hedgehog fur covers the face, short cactus spines and tiny blossoms replace the quill coat around the head and shoulders

species.name: Mushroom Owl
species.character: Nocturnal, thoughtful, and faintly luminous after rain.
species.promptCore: owl feather disks frame the face, small mushroom caps crown the head, speckled fungal markings glow softly along the cheeks

species.name: Lichen Snail
species.character: Unhurried and ancient; it wears its weather openly.
species.promptCore: a spiral snail shell overgrown with pale lichen rises behind the head, moist mollusk skin covers the cheeks, separate eye-stalks lift from the temples

species.name: Belladonna Frog
species.character: Bright, still, and not as harmless as it appears.
species.promptCore: glossy green frog skin covers the face, poisonous purple belladonna berries frame the shoulders, a wide amphibian smile crosses the lower face

species.name: Ivy Octopus
species.character: Clever and clinging; it leaves a pattern wherever it passes.
species.promptCore: violet octopus mantle replaces the crown of the head, suckered tentacles twine with ivy vines around the shoulders and jaw

species.name: Seed Pufferfish
species.character: Small pressure held inside a perfect roundness.
species.promptCore: round pufferfish head with olive seedpod markings, short botanical spines cover the cheeks and brow, a small pursed mouth sits below human eyes
